dedupe_keys.name: an operationally plausible thermoelectric power plant water use dataset for the united states data code

description: An Operationally Plausible Thermoelectric Power Plant Water Use Dataset for the United States - Data & Code is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Sjöstedt, Eric (deposited on HydroShare). Thermoelectric power was among the largest freshwater-withdrawing sectors in the U.S. as of the most recent complete U.S. Geological Survey national assessment (≈41% of withdrawals in 2015). Despite this scale of water use, existing datasets and raw U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) records often retain duplicates, inconsistencies, and operationally implausible values that hinder reproducible analysis. Coverage: United States. The resource was created 2025-08-08 and last updated 2026-09-29; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
